sources.fact: UCLA and Cal State LA survey of 26,437 women aged 18 to 65: 84% very satisfied with partner's size, 14% wished larger, 2% smaller; fewer than about 20% of women reliably orgasm from intercourse alone

Herbenick et al. (Indiana University), 1,055 women: about 18% orgasm from vaginal intercourse alone; 36% need clitoral stimulation; another 36% say it enhances orgasm; better orgasms reported with more time
Most women need direct clitoral stimulation to experience orgasm; penis size does not matter for most women's satisfaction
